interpretation: At the PETS mirror fit, doubling the point-estimate direct half-life within this constructed equivalence gauge requires nearly perfect negative correlation (about -0.9906) between the latent and observed innovations. The unbounded identified set demands a correlation magnitude approaching 0.99762 in this gauge. These are not empirical estimates of real shock correlations.
caveats: The latent Y in this gauge equals (Theta-(1-q)X)/q and is not independently established as an ecological variable.
A correlation cap requires separately justified biological measurement and interpretation of Y. None is available here.
Do not call near-perfect anticorrelation implausible from the model fit alone or infer which biological mechanism is true.
The original OUBM observable half-life remains statistically model-conditional and its published confidence uncertainty is distinct.
These fitted diffusion values are from the PETS mirror independent refit, not the authors' original Dryad source.
